proposed_change: Implement ADNI MRI protocol (T1-weighted, FLAIR) as baseline imaging standard in Medicalia preprocessing pipeline
Add biomarker cascade (CSF p-tau/Aβ42, plasma NfL, PET amyloid) as three-stage progression tracking in Medicalia diagnostic workflow
Integrate pretrained ADNI MRI models via transfer learning for MCI-to-Alzheimer conversion prediction with 85% target accuracy
Include Preclinical Alzheimer Cognitive Composite (PACC) items in Medicalia cognitive assessment battery for early detection
Build multi-modal fusion layer combining MRI, biomarker, and cognitive test data for improved prediction accuracy
Structure Medicalia longitudinal tracking for 5-year progression modeling with minimum 1000 subject baseline
Add ApoE4 genotype stratification to Medicalia risk scoring for individualized biomarker trajectory prediction
Implement modality selection logic: MRI-first with 15-20% PET upgrade option for amyloid-specific cases
Use random forest 82% accuracy as benchmark baseline for MCI conversion prediction in Medicalia validation suite
Add plasma Neurofilament Light chain (NfL) to Medicalia blood biomarker panel for neurodegeneration tracking
